The speed v of a transverse wave on a stretched wire is believed to depend on the tension F (a force) and the linear mass density mu (mass per unit length) according to the relationship:
v = C * F^p * mu^q
where C is a dimensionless constant, and p and q are unknown numerical indices.
(a) State the SI base units of v, F, and mu. [1]
(b) By equating powers of base units on both sides of the equation, determine the values of the indices p and q. [2]
